```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

# Data

## Parameters

```{r}
diseases <- c("RA", "PS", "PSA", "CD", "UC", "SLE")
```

## Metadata

```{r}
featureTable <- readRDS("../../../../../Data/Storage/Molecular/Proteomics/Plasma/2021_IMX_001_SOMAscan41_IA/Metadata/featureTable.rds")
```


## Results

```{r}
RES <- list()
for(dis in diseases){
  RES[[dis]] <- readRDS(paste0("../../Results/01_diseasePopulationMR_pQTL/01_OneSampleMR_CFMR/", dis, ".rds"))
}
```

## Put results together

```{r}
# MR estimation results
EST <- NULL
for(dis in diseases){
  EST[[dis]] <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(RES[[dis]]), function(x){
    res <- summary(RES[[dis]][[x]])
    res <- data.frame(t(res$coefficients["X", ]))
    names(res) <- c("Estimate", "StdErr", "TVAL", "PVAL")
    apt.name <- paste0("seq.", gsub("_", ".", x))
    symb <- featureTable$EntrezGeneSymbol[featureTable$AptName==apt.name]
    cbind(Prot=x, Symb=symb, res)
    }))
  
  EST[[dis]] <- EST[[dis]][order(EST[[dis]]$PVAL),]
}

# MR estimation results
DIA <- NULL
for(dis in diseases){
  DIA[[dis]] <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(RES[[dis]]), function(x){
    res <- summary(RES[[dis]][[x]])
    res <- data.frame(res$diagnostics)
    res$Method <- rownames(res)
    names(res) <- c("df1", "df2", "statistic", "PVAL", "Method")
    apt.name <- paste0("seq.", gsub("_", ".", x))
    symb <- featureTable$EntrezGeneSymbol[featureTable$AptName==apt.name]
    cbind(Prot=x, Symb=symb, res)
    }))
}
```


# Analyze

```{r}
for(dis in diseases){
  EST[[dis]] <- EST[[dis]][order(EST[[dis]]$PVAL),]
  print(EST[[dis]])
}
```
